text: This was our first trip to MTJ.  We've been wanting to go for a while.  Even though the rain was coming down in sheets we decided to brave the storm for their tacoie deliciousness!  We tried a little bit of everything.  I really enjoyed the fish and shrimp.  My husband liked the grilled chicken.  Beware of the churros!  They are great and the chocolate to die for.  Make your way over to MTJ!

We were staying in Franklin for a wedding weekend and decided to come here for a quick bite to eat before heading into the city. Little did we know that quick bite (biscuits and gravy, farm breakfast, 1 cap and 1 drip coffee) would take an hour wait! The food came out cold, potatoes were not cooked right, toast was missing butter, and they told us that we did not order a cappuccino. It's ridiculous even waiting that long for a regular drip coffee. My fiancé went downstairs to check and saw 3 gals behind the counter chit chatting while a long line continued to form. This place is managed so poorly and inefficiently. I would not recommend coming here on a Sunday morning.

Stopped in Dos Margaritas for their advertised 2 for 1 margaritas.  Not only did they change that 2/1 policy but the drinks we bought were weak as a kitten.  High prices and rude service here. Oh and we did call in advance to confirm the specials and were told they were on sale.

Horrible! I would never come here. The service is terrible. The waiter we had, acted like he didn't  even want be there. Asked about the specials. He didn't even know them, couldn't even tell us what was in the dish. Absolutely absurd! Waited another 30 minutes for our lunch. Which I think the waiter forgot to put our order in. The food was not good. I didn't even eat any of it. Most of the sides, that came with a dish didn't even make it too the table. I was glad to leave and never return. Poor
Want to wait 30 minutes for mediocre food? Then this is your place!! Lack of staff, plus employees were just talking in the kitchen while customers were waiting in line

Went for a weekday breakfast with the kids. Went once before for lunch and had a nice experience. Food was great, especially the home fries. We were greeted and seated right away. Our waitress was super friendly. Everyone enjoyed their breakfast. Definitely going back!
Pizza was excellent and the number to daily special was was also very good good deal I'm definitely going to go back

There's no doubt I will come back here. The Parmesan crab fries may have been some of the best fries that I've ever had. The sauce that can on them were amazing as well. I can literally go back just for them. The Mahi Mahi sandwich was great as well. It was seasoned just right and the bread had a nice toast to it. 

Mark our server was quick and efficient. He had many tables but was able to get everyone taken care of. If you're in the Franklin area do yourself a favor and check this place out!

We are from California. This was a Yelp pick and a c
ool place. It's big and roomy. Has a hand washing station was you walk in and a corn hole game outside. The wether was great for outside only slightly windy. 

We got the zucchini fries, the queso bowl, Thai peanut Bowl, Caesar salad, and chicken strips. 

The strips and the zucchini fries were great. The Milkshakes are also good and 1/2 off from 3-5pm. We were there at 2:50 and didn't know about the discount which stinks. 

The thai peanut bowl was just okay. Not the best. The salad was great though and the croutons were the bomb. Staff was friendly and place is clean! 

I'm giving one less star only because the bowls were luke warm and tasted just okay.

I think I'd come back for the strips and zucchini fries though.
Yuca fries are amazing. Always a great experience.  Drinks are delicious and food is carefully crafted.

Went here today for a light lunch. I got the islander açaí bowl and it was really good! I would definitely go back. Everything was fresh and tasted really good. The only downsides to this place was that the smoothie "drifter" (my sister got it) was really bad. It tasted like a chocolate protein shake or something. Wasn't a fan. Also it was a little pricy but was still very good. I recommend this place just know that it might not be the cheapest.

This is a brand new Longhorn Steakhouse.  unfortunately, I haven't had the opportunity to have a nice sit down dinner here yet. 

Tonight during this coronavirus and stay at home, we ordered some burgers for dinner. 

Everything went FLAWLESSLY!!  From the on-line ordering to the pick-up.  When we arrived to pick up there were signs directing you.  The parking spots were all numbered and the street was numbered as well. Longhorn was extremely organized!  The worker immediately approached our car, asked for a name and immediately returned with our bag of food. Everything was packaged nicely and was hot.  We couldn't be happier about how this pick-up went! 

When we returned home and began to unwrap our food my husband's first comment was "I probably got a hockey puck to eat". He said this because I eat my burgers "well done" and for some reason even tho he orders his "medium", it's usually served well done like mine.  When he cut into his burger it was medium and pink!!!  Thank you Longhorn!!!  For this I give you five stars!!!  You deserve it!!  We have dined in many establishments for burgers and they never get it right for some reason.  It's very frustrating for my hubby. 

I ordered a well done bacon cheeseburger with fries and it was delicious.  My hubby ordered a medium done bacon cheeseburger with a Mac & cheese side and it was perfect. Everything was enjoyed!

When the restaurants re-open I will definitely be coming to this Longhorn for a nice steak dinner!  

If you a

We had reservations at the restaurant next door, Tropez. We arrived 20 minutes early, however, Tropez gave our table away. When we arrived at IL Ritorno, we were very frustrated. The IL Ritorno hostess informed us it would be a 2.5 hour table wait for a group of six. Disheartened, we sat on their foyer bench searching unsuccessfully for another place to dine.  We were unaware she had shared our plight with the manager. He walked over to us and offered us a deal. If we could finish our meal in 1:30 minutes, he could seat us.  YEA!  We were then escorted to a private dining room with our choice of dinner music and a top notch wait staff.   The meal quality was exceptional.  The YELP ratings for this restaurant attest to the outstanding food quality. Keep in mind that it also has the best customer service of any restaurant we have frequented in DTSP. The staff seemed glad we were there, even if it meant rushing out extra meals on a night when the dining room was filled to capacity. After our meal, the manager came in to ensure our experience was top notch. It was!  We will be back!

This little New Hope gem is worth a visit. Word to the wise: either come early (I'm talking early bird special timing) or have a reservation. The Salt House is popular and gets crowded fast due to the unique confines of the historic building.

We were there on a Saturday night. Cocktails were outstanding. Our burgers were delicious, and the table service was excellent given that - at least twice - wait staff sincerely struggled to get to our table and others through the crowd around the main floor bar.

My only complaint is the number of patrons allowed in at the bar, literally pressing people standing into the table seated diners. One young lady stumbled backward and nearly fell on me, spilling my drink (she didn't apologize, by the way which was disappointing).

If not for the dense packing of human flesh, this would be a five star review as the restaurant owner has done an outstanding job in terms of food, drinks, atmosphere (which is truly unique, fun and interesting) and service. I totally get that old, beautiful buildings are tight on space, but bar patrons could be better managed once it is beyond standing room only.

All this being said, you must visit this establishment. But go early. Or on a weeknight.

Its always a gluttonous pleasure to indulge in one of New Orlean's oldest treats- the franchise of Cafe Du Monde. Fantastic & professional customer service, clean environment, this location is positioned within the mall in Metairie and a couple of miles from the stand alone location on Veterans Blvd. Of course, this isn't the famous one located within the French Quarter. 

Beignets, coffee, bottled water, and orange juice. That's about it, folks. Nothing fancy, nothing complicated. While there is a good amount of seating inside, there is also additional seating (more than likely a part of the mall) outside of the venue. And the beignet quality? Outstanding as always.
Went for brunch and had a great time! Cheap mimosas and wonderful entertainment. The performers were fantastic and the second showing at 1 featured multiple music genres.

Love love love!!! I'm a huge sushi lover and I never knew there was such thing as a "sushi bowl". Everytime I order from Poke Bros it gets better and better. It's always fresh for me, the pricing isn't bad for the amount you receive, and it's always portioned perfect. I highly recommend if you like sushi, because this may just blow your mind!

Best local neighborhood bar around. Great drink specials, awesome service. The frozen drinks are some of the best in town. Literally the best place to watch local sports-especially Saints games!! No food, but they often have food trucks. Namely the Asian fusion food truck with is bomb.
Holy moly! This place is absolutely amazing. From the apps and pizza to the atmosphere. Also, a huge fan of the old fashioned. I can honestly say that this place makes you feel just like family.
Best breakfast sandwiches ever. The fully loaded is AMAZINGG!!!!! You will not be disappointed. An assortment of great choices.

Best Chicken sandwich in Nashville!  

If your a burger or chicken sandwich fan, and you haven't stopped by here, stop what your doing and get on the Hugh Baby's train!!! Warning you will go back!

Great sandwich's 
Great shakes
Great service!

HIGHLY recommend
Excellent breakfast place with a hard working staff. Food was delicious! Highly recommended when in Boise.

Word of mouth sent me in search of "The best Key Lime Pie" and of course while there I sampled the quiche which was rich,  creamy and full of flavor. I ordered the 3 slices of pie deal for 10.95 and picked the Chocolate Mousse, Coconut Cream and the Key Lime. The pies are all delicious as was the quiche. Nice people and cute restaurant. Next time I will try a sandwich, I do wish they had some gluten free bread but I was informed that they could make a whole gluten free pie if given notice so that's awesome! My daughter said the crust rocked on the Quiche, I ate around it even though it killed me to do so. Darn gluten insensitivity. Anyway, go try the Boise Pie Company out I don't think you'll be disappointed.

First time here was yesterday for the hockey game! Great place to watch the game plenty of TVs. Bathroom was very clean and the staff is friendly. I had the chicken quesadillas and they were amazing. I look forward to going back!
The food was great all the workers were friendly and made sure my family was taken care of.

My husband has ordered from here before but we decided to come on a Monday because neither of us wanted to cook. This place was definitely popular as there were a good amount of people there. We got the sweet and sour chicken, General Tso's chicken, two egg rolls as that was a part of the coupon if you spend $20 or I believe it's $18 actually. I also got the shrimp egg foo young. Everything was super tasty. Even on my diet day I was picking up my husband's chicken hahaha. Not all of the staff wear masks but the lady that was tending the counter does. Overall the food was pretty on par with your average Chinese to-go food. If in the area definitely stop by for some to go Chinese food.

Went during lunch. We ordered from lunch special menu and from the regular menu. The appetizer was cold, the waitress never brought us plates to eat off of and she disappeared. Didn't come back to see if everything was ok. Only came when she brought the bill. This place has gone down hill. Very disappointed in the service and the food. Too many people doing nothing and not helping each other out. I think the grandkids are running it now. Won't be going back anytime soon!

Food and service are great (would rate a 4 star).  Stupidity of management leaving all doors open and no air conditioning when outside temperature is 86 degrees (feels like 88) is beyond stupidity (would rate less than one star).

Disclaimer: The 3 stars has NOTHING to do with the food. My go to order for my family and I is the salt and pepper shrimp, salt and pepper chicken and chicken fried rice nothing else and the salt and pepper shrimp are my ABSOLUTE fav meal I usually eat an order to myself. I could probably eat them everyday if I wasn't concerned about high salt content. 
Anyways, my 3 stars are solely because the customer service is horrible I thought at first it was a cultural thing you know, the strictness and short flat temperament of the staff but now I just think they're mean. One time in 2019 they were closed for a while and I felt like every time I went for food they were closed so once I caught them open and went in I attempted to have small talk with a waiter asking "hey you guys have been closed for a while what happened?" And I was bluntly told "you have break right?!" So rude in my opinion I was excited to be a patron again just to be put in my place I guess you can say. We are nothing more than cash flow to them and I feel bad saying this because I'll continue to be a customer because of that salt and pepper recipe  So for the maybe more sensitive folk who want to feel valued where they spend money BEWARE the chances of a friendly interaction are little to none staff wise. 
Oh and they stay open late so this is an after the club hit. Maybe the late nights aggravate them idk.
Great Breakfast and lunch at reasonable prices. Only had bad service once in the year I've been going there. It can get quite busy but they always keep up and get food out quick.

Ambiance is not good. Nachos are ok nothing special. Chips way to salty, ground beef tooo spicy. I will not return. No diet drinks, no unsweetened tea, water bottle cost 1.59 for reg water you can get 34 for $3.00 at Walmart. 
I rather nachos from El Paso.

Been wanting to check this place out for a bit, but just haven't made the time. I'll definitely be back!
I was here for brunch - the server, Stephanie EXCELLENT!!!.. 
A people person, gave great suggestions, allowed us to  enjoy our meal - while not making us feel as though she forgot about us. I had Eggs Benedict w/ Crab, I changed it to scrambled eggs ( I'm not a fan of poached) wasn't a fan of the English muffin a little tough. But generous portion of crab. I wonder if they'll add Fried Green Tomatoes to the menu

Visited Boise, ID for the first time during Valentine's Day weekend. This little grill was our first stop after leaving the airport. Great service and good food. If you are looking for great simple food without all the other fanfare, this is a great spot.  I had lunch and hubby had breakfast.

Don't be fooled by the non-traditional menu - this place is outstanding. I played it safe with tacos, which were amazing, but everything else at the table was fabulous. Aside from the food, the atmosphere is very unique and fun.

Saw this on the YELP top 100 and we are glad we went! 
Steak & Eggs was on point! Skewered beef medallions, cooked to order (med rare) and good quality beef. Subbed the breakfast potatoes for the hash browns, MUST DO! Added a cup of gravy, to top everything off...Very good! 
We also had the A2Z w/ Spam delicious! We will be back!!

Greenhouse is my favorite pub and restaurant in New Hope besides my own. James and Tom are my favorite server/bartenders. Trivia with Dwayne is awesome for Trivia night. My week isn't complete until I have a cocktail and the thick cut bacon platter. If you want a great night out and a fun night, you need to stop by Greenhouse.
This place is filthy. Any time ive been there the floors are dirty and littered with paper or food and the counters are grimy with food and paper strewn about.looks like its totally unmanaged.

Hey. Yeah, you. It wasn't too long ago that I  was in your shoes, browsing yelp looking for something to eat. I just finished my meal from Philly Tacos and I am now coming to you as a PROPHET. This place is just different. After sharing a laugh over the phone with the nice woman who had to endure my broken spanish, I got the short rib special Tacos (not what they're actually called, but it's the one with the cactus) and a steak quesadilla delivered. Upon taking a bite I had to refrain from packing up my bags and moving into their dining room. All of the ingredients were fresh and I was given cheese, half of an avocado, and tomato on the side. There is no picture because I left no evidence. They are not playing around. If you're on the fence, don't be. Pull the trigger and thank me later.

Cute atmosphere and good food. However, we had terrible service. Would have ordered more food and likely more drinks but the waitress did not come around again after taking our first order. Had to ask the hostess to get our check. 

Food:
the roasted broccoli: super tasty, healthy and spicy aioli was also good.
cauliflower mash: small, but delicious. Like cheesy mashed potatoes.
Patatas bravas: not the best. Incredibly spicy and I've had much better elsewhere
Manchego y membrillo: cute little bites, delicious and recommend.

Make a reservation through Resy.

I ordered a Rib Sandwich & Brisket sandwich thru Uber Eats. I was very tired after working 10 days @ the hospital and just wanted to go home..For the very first time ever, The Ribs were tough and dry and the Jumbo sandwich looked like a $5 meal from Burger King, not to mention the fact that it was very salty. I called to speak to the manager who told me to bring the food back to them. Okay???? what am I to do get the Ribs out of the dumpster??? 
Sorry Jack's can't support you or advise anyone to come there till you get your act together. I don't have $31.00 to throw away.

Gotta love these street tacos! The fish taco had excellent flavor and was loaded with toppings. I also ordered a delicious side of black beans. They added the perfect "heartiness" to my lunch. Chips and salsa were tasty, especially the verde salsa. Wish I'd been able to try a margarita- next time!
Ate in. Food was good, our server was great. Hostess was less than friendly. But the ladies  bathroom was a horror! Filthy. Can't imagine how they allow this.

We went to the Lucky Penny for the first time last night and had a really interesting experience that I'd like to share. 

We arrived around 6:45 and, since it was a Saturday night, the restaurant was extremely busy. Knowing that seating is first come, first served, I scouted a table while my boyfriend waited in line to order. After waiting for about 30 minutes, a table opened up and I sat down. As soon as I sat down, I was accosted by two women who shouted at me that I couldn't sit there because I didn't have a number, and that they had been waiting longer than me and they deserved the table over me. I told them that my boyfriend was in line ordering and they called me a liar. I offered to share the table and they told me that they didn't want to share and that I needed to get up. They weren't backing down and were causing a scene, so I walked away and let them have the table.

What I didn't see while I was waiting for the table was that these women were part of a larger group that had been waiting for a table and getting impatient. My boyfriend saw them in line and said that they were yelling at the manager, Amy, about the wait. He shared with me that Amy tried to de-escalate the women and remind them that seating was first come-first served. They were being extremely rude to the staff and didn't seem to understand the seating concept, but the piece that I want to focus on with my review is just how kind and calm the whole staff remained during this time. 

After the alterc

Went here today and waited in line for a few minutes before i realized none of the staff were wearing masks or gloves. Watched someone handling food in the kitchen, literally wipe their nose and then continue to make a wrap. This is unacceptable whether we are in a pandemic or not. 

Beyond this, I agree with previous reviews. The owner and staff are insanely rude. I've had several bad experiences with them but continue to come back because its located near my office. But it's almost like they don't want your business and want you to leave? I've never seen anything quite like it...its a highly uncomfortable experience every time. Won't be returning again.

I am not a beer lover and certainly not a beer connoisseur but I have to say that the food here made up for my lack of knowledge in beers. I was very impressed with the menu and the outright amazing flavors of the food. We luckily got a really nice table right at the window and enjoyed people watching. The tomato special was so delicious. The chicken sandwich I chose for the burger selection was melt in your mouth good. My friend ordered the Thai style mussels and said they were the best they ever had. Really good experience here now just have to expand my beer palate.
Went here for an early lunch at 11. It was great tasting pepperoni pizza!! The soda from the fountain drink was a bit off. But the pizza was really good and we also had the cannolis. Very tasty!!
Great staff, excellent food quality and portions. While in the area for work, I probably ate Casapullas 3-4 times a week.

Probably my best meal in New Orleans and that's saying something. The waiters descriptions of all the dishes left me using my napkin to wipe the drool away. It also didn't make my decision any easier. Ultimately I went with the scallops and was completely happy with my choice. The food and service were both excellent. If you're in New Orleans and you're looking for a great meal this is the place to go!!!

During my visit to the new Test Kitchen at Sun King in the Fishers District,   I ordered some food from Korave.  This restaurant is run by the a pair of brothers (John and Kim) who left South Korea for culinary school in Utah, and then ended up with a food truck in central Indiana.  Their main focus is on Korean BBQ in this new location.

Although they are known for their rice bowls and poutine, I decided to go with the Street Taco medley and a side order of Mandoo (fried chicken dumplings.)

The tacos were fantastic.  I wasn't sure which meats were included in the medley, but each one tasted delicious!  Soft shell flour tortillas come with mixed greens, some pickled items, and sauces that bring out a complex layering of food that is easy to eat.  I didn't have a favorite:  they were all good!

The Mandoo comes with five dumplings that are nestled over some fresh shredded veggies and lightly coated with a sauce.  They were crisp and the ingredients were tasty, but I am used to having a dipping sauce for my dumplings.  So even though I asked, they didn't have anything to dip in.  That would be appreciated.  The portion sizes were fair for the prices.  Not too large.  I was easily able to eat the three tacos while my wife ate most of the Mandoo.

Basically, you go to the specific counter for the restaurant, place your order and pay, and are given a sensor that will buzz when your order is ready.  That allows time to find a table and place a beer order from Sun King.  (Note that

Good service and nice family atmosphere.
Food was okay but nothing special.
Worth stopping in - if you are in the area.
Great staff.
It was Amazing i got  seafood boil with the king crab and Dungeness crab cluster the best 88 dollars i spent

This place is excellent !! Superb service!  Everyone smiling, servers helping each other, talking laughing. Food amazing !  Hot and delish ! Servings are huge! Super clean !  The energy in this place Rocks !! It it won't empty the wallet ! We highly recommend to everyone who visits St Petersburg !

LOVE LOVE LOVE this coffee shop! I am hooked on them, no seriously. I live 30 minutes away and make the drive happily, just to have another cup of their delicious coffee. Also a plus, their food is amazing. Customer service is great as well, everyone is super mellow here.

First time I went I really underestimated the place, the outside isn't to appealing and the drive-thru through me off ( very xonve. I thought will this be like another Starbucks ? I was so wrong. Went inside and the place is super cute & cozy(couch is so comfy). Interior is very simple & organized. I think it has a good amount of seating and I never have trouble with parking when I come.

I've gone 3 times in a row since I first went. Always order my iced latte with caramel& vanilla flavor. Their coffee is strong, that's my favorite part and very unique tasting. It is lightly sweetened and taste just right. I'm not sure of their method when making their coffee but it always has a nice fluffy creamy foam on top,whether you order a hot or iced latte. It's so good and just thinking about it makes me want one. Friends & family members think the same.

Food is delicious. VEGAN options as well, so kudos to them. I've had the avocado salmon toast & the lemon aioli biscuit, and both are scrumptious. Their pastry items are as well. Very good prices compared to other coffee shops on Tampa.

They have a reward program which is always a plus. Every 5 drinks , you earn a FREE one. This is very fair and will keep me comi
Love their draft sangria! Food is always on point as well, the only thing that stinks is the parking

Great restaurant! When visiting the French Quarter in New Orleans definitely stop by for dinner! The food and service were excellent! Great deco . The place gets busy so I would definitely recommend making reservations. This was my first visit to New Orleans and always wanted to eat my way through the city and this place was a great start. I started off with a sazerac and when in NOLA you have to have a sazerac and i was not disappointed. I then ordered the duck spring rolls which were great and then ordered the shrimp and grits, omg amazing! And we the meal with the hot buttered pecan pie. The pie delicious! It is pretty sweet and great to share. I really think whether you are a local or a visitor to the French Quarter I would highly recommend the restaurant and I don't think you will be disappointed! Enjoy

Was thrilled when I found out Dukes was coming to Brandon. Their Plant City location has always been fantastic. Service was good even though they were quite busy. Mel helped us and she was great! We ordered a nacho appetizer, 2 kid meals, a black and blue burger, and a ton of wings. I also tried their Spiked Strawberry Lemonade. Food was great! One of the best burgers I've ever had. My husband said the wings weren't spicy enough but they were still good. They have a large outdoor deck that's screened in, live music, a arcade games. Will be back for more.

We were greeted and seated immediately. Only 4 other tables were here since we were eating early so it was very quite. The background music was playing at a nice volume to hear and maintain a conversation.

Our server was patient as I was having difficulty deciding on my order. My husband was hungry for breakfast which is why we're here. He ordered the Western Omelette with hash browns and pancakes as his bread. He enjoyed and devoured all of his meal.

I ordered the Country Fried Steak smothered in white gravy, mashed potatoes with gravy and grilled zucchini. The zucchini was cooked perfectly, the mashed potatoes were creamy and the Country Fried Steak was tender and the gravy was tasty. 

Our server was great, very friendly, attentive and prompt. I love when you need a to-go box and they bring with a bag without me asking.

Breakfast was tasty, meals arrived timely, afforable, large portions and great service.

Some of the best food in Reno. The old school gnocchi is amazing. Meatballs are fantastic. Gluten free chocolate cake was delicious. Would love to see a little more professionalism from the wait staff. It's a small dining room, so hard to hide the fact that my food is in the window and the bartender and server are busy chatting. Also a little more team work: took two servers to figure out the hostess was going to be taking a to-go order for a while and someone else needed to seat us.

Small issues, overall fantastic.

The reason I'm giving this location two stars is because no matter the time I go the wait is way too long. I will give it to the workers as they do work hard and sadly when I did go there was only three of them dealing with a packed drive-thru as well as people waiting inside. And out of those three one of those people had to be the cook so you can imagine how short-staffed they were. For a place that is usually this busy you would think that they would have more staff on hand to help out. I would say that the chicken was very good and everything was well cook as I expect from Popeyes however it was concerning that during the time of COVID-19 some staff members were wearing their masks under their chin and on occasion no gloves when handling food. personally I wouldn't care for that even if there were not a pandemic but during this time when people are catching it left and right I would hope that food workers would take these things a little bit more seriously. It will probably be a while before I come back to this location.

Things were good as far as COVID safety precautions. Tables were spaced out correctly. I had happened to sit in a little nook in the back of the restaurant. The table was really nice & the atmosphere was great. The waitress we had was really sweet & took her time with all of her guests. The food was okay. I got carnitas tacos. I was expecting more of a cultural menu. The tortilla's were street style & the actual tortilla itself was very soggy. The pork on the taco was chewy. Just the overall quality of my meal was not the best. I also got the fried plantains & they were very sour tasting & burnt on the outside. I'm not too sure if I'm going to give this place another try. Maybe asking for a recommendation next time would be best.

I really love this place, the hummus and pita is one of my favorites. The service could be better, it has slowly declined over the years. I usually get the shawarma but the kitchen was out of it today. I tried the sautéed chicken cilantro and it was not "creamy" or flavorful as the menu described it. It was alright but coming from a Lebanese restaurant I was excepting more of a kick in taste. The server was not as knowledgeable with the menu and couldn't describe what the meals tasted like. My review would be five stars if these aspects were improved. 
 
EDIT* was writing this as we were finishing up. I left the server a small tip, it was better than nothing. The server saw the tip and aggressively asked if everything was okay. After I smiled and said "it was alright" he threw the menu at the table next to us. Can't expect a generous tip if you didn't work for it!

I had given Panera Westbank many chances but this was it.  The first two chances involved two steak on everything bagels in which I had to look for and rearrange the one slice of meat.  I had had them from this location before to know that this wasn't the norm.  The other time involved the manager making an unnecessary amount of noise with the pans in addition to talking loud in front of the patrons.  Another time was my experience with a stone faced employee who I have never seen with a smile on her face.  She is not inviting which should be a requirement if business is wanting customers.  In addition, she was an older lady which is alarming because she isn't setting an example for the younger employees.

Yesterday I ordered a Rapid Order and picked it up to take home.  Once home, I noticed that there wasn't a piece of chicken on the half southwest chile lime chicken salad that I ordered.  I called the restaurant and the person I spoke to didn't offer my money back but offered a whole salad when I returned and that the information would be left on a sticky note.  When I returned the next day, I saw the stoned face employee and was hoping she didn't serve me.  Well, she ended up doing so and I told her the story and she requested to see my receipt and notecard with the notes from the telephone call the day prior (about the whole salad for the error).  She marked my receipt as received and told someone in the kitchen to make the salad.  When it was ready, it was a half and I s
Best ceviche I've ever had in my life. It is a little pricey but worth it. Their salsas are also amazing. I can't wait to come again. I would highly recommend it.

A
Local joint, in a little but upscale town. I have to admit, the name is great and the bar is, well a bar. But it has style. The beer list is nothing short of amazing. The food was, at first glance, looking like something that was standard. I ordered the pulled pork with Italian hot peppers. It was transcendent!

I have to say, all in all, I really, really like this place. There was just something about it, a Certain Raison de etre, that really made it worth coming back to.

I will be back...

First time visiting, food was good with lots of variety. My only complaint is to fix your equipment. I had the entire length of an eight foot booth fall on top of me because it wasn't attached to the frame. All it takes is five minutes and a couple of screws.

Love this place. When i was in freshmen year three years ago I guess there were different owners. When I started coming here laat year, i found my hidden gem in IV. Whenever I crave sushi or authentic Korean food, I go here. Usually the beef/clam tofu stew (ORDER EXTRA SPICY****) and I really like the Sushiya roll. Owner and his daughters are super nice and always greet me with a smile. Im sad to leave this place after grad in June. Its been a comfort food place!

Went here about three weeks ago. I went to the french market just for a crab cake po'boy. It was so good! I would just say it could've been a little firmer (the crab cakes) however it was amazing and the roasted potatoes were amazing as well. Grateful to have been recommended to this place from a great teacher of mine who also says the family is good people also!
Great brewery and a great location in a great facility. The first sausages were a very interesting item on the menu and would recommend them. Coleslaw was great as well.

If there is a place to avoid it's this place. Food is greasy and service sucks. 
It all starts the moment you walk in. Very dirty. There was food and flour all over the side of the glass in the customer waiting area. The other nasty thing is they pre-prep pizza dough and place it in holding racks right in front of waiting customers, no glass partition. Anyone could cough or sneeze on your pie. 
Their counter help sucks. No one seems to be trained. Told them who I was, auto response was "Ok, 10mins" even though I placed my order 30mins prior and they never checked for my pizza or looked at an order in the computer. 
Won't go back. Food was subpar for what i paid for.
Hey guys I'm at The Midwestern, just finished eating Big Baby Q's BBQ some of best in the Midwest! Sorry I didn't take a picture of my food it was looking so good I started eating too fast lol.

Ordered via Grubhub delivery. Food arrived cold. Did not receive the extra tartar sauce that I paid for. Fried clam strips were doughy and undercooked. Reheating them in toaster oven didn't improve them. Flavorless hush puppies. Cole slaw container leaked all over me and the bag. I got so excited when I saw Ipswich clams on the menu...I grew up near there. What a huge disappointment.

Amazing sandwiches. Elaine is cordial, explains out the menu if you have questions, invites you in, makes you feel at home, - good people. The combinations of meats to cheese to mustard to veggies is SPOT ON. She makes a great sandwhich, worth your time and money.

Saw the very low rating but figured no big deal. All Domino's have low ratings. I should know better. 
Ordered the pizza online. Got the text that it was ready. Show up and the employee has no idea what order I'm talking about. Answers her phone. Walks away. Then comes back and asks if this was my order while reading a sticker. Told me it wasn't made and to come back for it. I was on my lunch break and couldn't come back. Left with no pizza and got a refund. Sucks.

Tried tonight first time. Egg Foo Young was cooked perfectly and reminiscent of back east - good, loose and liquidy with chicken cooked within the patty. Excellent sticky white rice and wife loved the Singapore Noodles. Everything cooked fresh and hot. Nice owners with amazing customer service. Will be back and you gotta try.

Sad to say as much as we usually like the food, we will not be going back. One thief ruined it for us. We made a purchase by debit card yesterday for $27.18 and today I saw that transaction and another one for $42.40. Luckily my husband was able to go down and verify that yes I had signed the first receipt but there was no signature on the 2nd one. He was given a refund but it still makes me so weary of ever going back. Everyone be aware of your transactions! Funny thing is that I felt like the girl was doing something shady because she took so long to run my card. She probalby purchased dinner for her family on me! So keep an eye out for employee with the bright red lipstick and doesn't know how to appy makeup!
Absolutely love VIP, best margaritas, great food, fantastic service. It's small and you have to wait, but that's just part of the fun.
Tonight Dear friend and I were delighted with both our platters. She had eggplant parm Id chicken parm - both came with pasta and salad and both were delicious 5/5 stars

In anticipation of a fun night with friends from out of town who wanted to head down to University. Came early to Frog & Firkin for the UofA vs. St.Johns basketball game during a crisp cool Tucson night, surrounded by like minded fans to enjoys the hopeful victory, asked management to put the audio on for the basketball game after listening to the 49ers vs. Rams game outside before the 8pm MST tip off. Instead had to listen to the radio outside the entire game.... Many others fans including my group where thoroughly disappointed of the fandom and spirit of the staff/ Manager of Frog & Firkin. Hopefully next time it's not during a crucial or tournament game???

Friendly employees and a delicious muffuletta! My husband and I shared a half because if you didn't know, these sandwiches are gigantic. All the the ingredients are absolutely delicious, the bread was great, but in my opinion just a little bit dry. The olive salad was super tasty and really made the sandwich. Cute little shop with bar like seating.
I went to this restaurant because of the high rate. I ordered the oyster platter and feel like I was eating fried chicken. I was disappointed by this entree.
The customer service is terrible. It might be a good idea for management to hire people who WANT to work there. I don't need attitude along with my brownie.

This is by far our favorite fast food chain. Burgers are always so juicy, fresh, and the best cheese curds always made to order. So much better than french fries!  

Great variety of frozen custard flavors too - much better than even going to a Baskin Robin's, for instance. 

Only disappointment about this location is that they got our order wrong several times.  It's the closest to our condo though, so we still go there all the time. We still love Culver's too much haha

Great convenient spot. Been here at least 10 times already.  Obviously not the best prices but you are paying for convenience and pretty upscale for a convenience store. They have everything you could want and make anything you want at the deli in a wawa style fashion, except better quality.  I believe this is family owned and so far all of the staff are very nice and are very helpful. Have a lot of healthy and organic options and the quality of all of their items is definitely above average.  I only ever complain about the higher prices, but the convenience is worth it.
We have come several times over the past 40 years. It is not up to the old standards. Entry did not appear clean. Over priced for quality. Marginal service. Won't return.

Kicked out because I was Gay and didn't tip. They called the police because I took a strap off my overalls . The bouncers dragged me out and left marks on me. This is the third time they've made homophobic comments .

I order through  the app which uses Grub Hub.  When I placed the order it said it would be delivered in 30-50 minutes.  I live door to door 1.9 miles. About 10 minutes in the deliver time changed to deliver in 50 to 70 minutes.  I called the grub hub customer contact number at 80 minutes. I was hung up on twice and then after 120 minutes I called back and told them to give me my money back.  I suggest Muscle Maker Grill keep an eye on Grub Hub's service and consider another option.  Grub Hub will cost them business.  I won't use them again through Grub Hub.

Though the website and menu feature a Sunday Brunch, this is currently not offered.  We and another group beside us asked for brunch and we were laughed off by the server.  

Instead, a lunch menu is offered on Sunday.  We tried the chowder, the wedge, a scallops basket and some grouper tacos and all were excellent.  Only 2 rotating taps were offered but both were local and seasonal.
I love this place! The chocolate long johns are by far my favorite! All of the doughnuts are great! I've always had a great experience every time I go in! I highly recommend this place!

I ended up placing an order at the restaurant, and not dining in and they actually add a "service charge of 10%" for an order that I am taking/picking up. Personally to me this isn't right and consumers should have the right to know. Now if I were dining in I 100% understand because you should "tip" your waiter. However I disagree if I AM NOT dining in! After this I will never be coming back again!!!

When we first arrived we were slightly thrown off on the check in experience but once seated this was an exceptional dining experience - from our wait to the support staff and of course the actual food. We went all out and tried everything that appealed to us (what the heck were only here once!) and I am so glad we did because it was all unbelievable. From the cobia and tuna tartare to start to the popular goat curry we were blown away. The pork tenderloin is a dish that was so special for something that feels so classic and I'm not sure I'll have another like it!

I love this place! I always have received awesome service, great food and drinks. I love the atmosphere of the outside seating area where I can hang out with my dog and enjoy a nice drink and a snack. :)

I'm giving it 2 stars only because it was my first order so I can't say the whole menu is bad, but I was very disappointed in our order.  I had shrimp and corn bisque which had absolutely no flavor at all.  It wasn't creamy like a bisque normally is, it was almost like drinking water.  I also ordered a roast beef and Swiss panini.  The bread was barely toasted so it was soggy when I got it.  They also did not use real roast beef for the panini or my moms roast beef grinder.  It was a really rubbery cheap lunch meat roast beef that I wouldn't feed to my dog. I probably won't try it again

I love this place. Not only is the food always perfect every time the owner even offered to deliver my food out to my car so I wouldn't have to bring my baby inside. He said next time just call and let me know I'll bring it out to you! Amazing food and service!!!

Great "neighborhood bar" feel. A multitude of tasty beer and food options and an interesting juxtaposition of traditional bar food with sushi alternatives. All very tasty and delivered by knowledgeable, friendly staff, who do everything possible to ensure you have a good time. High on the list of places to go for a "repas a deux" or in a group of friends./colleagues.
Our family loves their pizza we been there for four weeks in a row since the outbreak and usually get to the three pizzas at one time. Love the place best pizza around our area.

Nick is one of the finest bartenders that I have found in the past decade. His cocktails are generous and perfectly balanced. Every single hostess, server, barback, and other staff member was courteous, helpful, and nonstop in theIr effort to create an absolutely amazing dining experience. The creations coming out of the kitchen were each perfect  in their own way. The potato-leek potage was warming, the branzino and short rib were bursting with flavor and the desserts were fantastic. We will ABSOLUTELY return to Townsend.

Lover of Chick-fil-A!  Known to visit at least once or twice a week. Lately (as in the past couple of months) there's a difference. My go to is the spicy chicken sandwich combo. The chicken now has a chewiness  (slight toughness)to it leaving it less desirable. I've tried giving the Chick-fil-A  several tries (not wanting to give up on my favorite place) but each time it's the same result. The frys are now typically served half fresh on top and beneath are the older smaller ends of pieces to fill up the remaining portion of the box. I've given this plenty of time to be corrected as well and yet dissatisfied.
Decent but has room to build! My piada tasted amazing but there was definitely no meat in there. I'll get it again but with more meat.

VERY disappointed. Had been a couple of times before... it was decent. Now it's barely edible. The 'Southwest Chicken Salad' was processed chicken that came with a packet of dressing (Ranch), we requested aSouthwestern dressing and were informed they only have the packaged Ranch or Bleu Cheeses. 

The salsa is watery and bland. The chips are sore bought. The refried beans and rice are flavorless. The side of beans were so watery we left them along with the rice and chips and salsa (we ordered take out for someone at home)

When we asked to speak to the manager to express our concerns (we had already paid the bill).. he was pleasant but lied about the food saying "Everything is made fresh here" And blamed the lack of quality on someone new. He did give us each a gift card. 

I'll use it for drinks. Will NEVER order food again

My wife & I wanted to go somewhere local, for dinner tonight, and hadn't been to Bertucci's in awhile.  I was just looking for a bowl of soup, and spaghetti & meatballs. Who would think, that would be a tough order for an Italian restaurant ?  To say it may very well have been the worst spaghetti & meatballs I've ever had, might just be an understatement. The meatballs were the size of ping pong balls & were so burnt & rubbery they could have probably bounced higher.  Again, when an Italian restaurant can't do a decent dish of spaghetti, it's probably time to lock the doors.

I was in the area so I stopped by. I had a nice time. The food was awesome. The atmosphere was nice. My server Corey was nice, fast and enjoyable. He told me about the happy hour specials, didn't get it but I'll be sure to get one next time. To say I was by myself I had a nice time. So shout out to the bar crew With Aaron way

Service was a amazing Shondra made our night very special. Food was great too 
Definitely coming back when we are in town

Urban Juicer is one of my favorite places for smoothies in all of Nashville. I frequent the one on 8th - it's the closest one for me. There isn't much indoor seating, but I'm usually taking it to go anyway.

I love a few different smoothies on their menu. I feel like they're consistently well done and made perfectly. Everyone that works there is always friendly and helpful too - which makes a big difference in my book. They do have limited / unique hours (in my opinion) so be sure to check before you go!

I would highly recommend trying Urban Juicer though - even over the other many similar places in town. I'm not certain but it seems like you get a little more for your money than some other places too. I've tried a lot of others and Urban Juicer is still the best, in my opinion. I wish they'd open a location near Brentwood, but it's probably best for my finances that they don't. ;)

I got to try El Paisano due to a Yelp event. In honor of Latinx Heritage Month, I was going to try a pupusa plate! I had an asada taco added to it.
There was some confusion in my orders in a two day period, but they were fixed immediately! Staff is helpful! 
The atmosphere was cozy and quiet, everyone following Covid protocol.
There are so many options on the menu! I look forward to trying everything! 
The food is delicious! Authentic. I highly recommend!

Stopped by Blind Tiger today for a coffee and ordered the Dirty Thai-ger. It was a delicious and refreshing drink on a hot and humid day! The cafe is super cute and is following physical distancing and Covid-19 guidance including reduced seating. This would be a cute place to study and hangout under other circumstances but some people still were which is nice! I can't wait to come back and try their other coffee drinks!
You don't see many five stars with this many reviews. That should tell you everything you need to know. This place is a hidden gym in North county. You won't find better Thai in the STL area

Was on vacation in Tampa and found this sweet spot so you know I had to make the 25 minute drive to this place! First off, the location was perfect. You could tell everyone in there was a local. It was a Tuesday night around 9pm, so it wasn't as busy as I presumed the weekends were. Was very low-key w/ a unique ambiance, and they had 90's hip hop playing (my fav). My friend and I got buzzed off their "Pain Killer" frozen cocktail (2 each) that was pre made. All of the bartenders were very laid back w/ great customer service. One of them gave us good bar/restaurant recommendations and the other bartender saw a very drunk girl and gave her free fries to help her sober up!! I mean come on!! If that isn't great care/service I Dont know what is! Overall had a good experience here and would definitely recommend to anyone curious about this place.

A 'fresh' option for lunch and dinner in South Tampa. A surprisingly large variety of selections using fresh ingredients. Fantastic service and really good prices. Order at the counter and your food is delivered to your table.. Eat in or get it to go.  Spacious interior and outdoor seating. Can't believe I have not been to Bull Market  This is undoubtedly one of my new favorite go-to restaurants!!!

Waited an hour, which is to be expected on a nice night in Franklin. However, if I'm gonna stick it out for an hour it better be some great food. Had the crab fried and they were great, so definitely had high hopes for the rest of the meal. Ordered the grilled shrimp salad. At a seafood place I'm expecting nice big shrimp, that are actually grilled and have that nice grill flavor and charred edges. Boy oh boy what I got was basically raw shrimp that had hit a pan of butter for about 5 seconds and put on a plate. They were still blue. Truly disgusting. My friend ordered the catfish dinner and the breading was soggy, the fish undercooked, and the tartar sauce.....holy cow......that tartar was an abomination. It taste like the white fruit dip that comes with a fruit tray from Wal Mart. Asked if we got the right thing and was told "it's our version of tartar". It's cool to make a spicy tartar or something in that realm, but this was so far off the mark. Not worth the wait and definitely not going back.
This was delicious.  Service exceptional. Thanks Lee for an amazing meal and great time.
It stated that it was going to be Latin night... all I heard was half a seconds of Latin music followed by some EDM. Not even good at that. Would not recommend for the supposed "latin night".

All of the sushi and beef are extremely fresh and delectable. The Korean cauliflower is to die for and drinks are well made. I would recommend the Santa Barbara Sling or the Scorpion Shell  (To Share). Views are incredible and they even have a fireplace on the second floor deck! Excellent spot for lunch with a wide variety on the menu! Complimentary Valet Parking in the back of the restaurant as well! Great spot for work lunches, private groups, or a romantic date out. Finally SB has sushi on the water!

Without a doubt this is the very best steakhouse in town. Jimmy has done an absolute fabulous job in creating an atmosphere mixed with unbelievable food. The chef Tyler and general manager Will, take the overall experience and make it one of the very best places in all of St. Louis.

Lovely bar with a lovely view of the water! Visited on Valentine's Day for some pre-dinner cocktails. Sat at the bar and had the Midsummer Nights Dream, which tasted great. There was a short period where it rained and the guests seated on the patio crowded underneath the covered awning surrounding the bar but I would too if I was getting rained on! Wonderful spot to relax.

We arrived Saturday night around 5:00 pm. Got seated right away, as we were in a group that had a table saved for us. I ordered the blackened chicken salad without dressing. Yum!!! Fresh and a lot of chicken. I didn't see any avocado but It was so good that was ok. Hubby ordered a turkey burger and said it was good. Kiddo had the fish- hubby tried it and said it was pretty good. Our server was nice and attentive. They got the bill a little mixed up but fixed it right away.

Y'all this place knows what it's doing. Never in my life did I think cauliflower could be lovable. Until today. I ordered the cauliflower cone with 24K sauce and pineapple coleslaw on top and it was delicious in every way. Not over or under breaded, not over or under sauced, just perfect. I will 100% be returning to try their shrimp next. 

My boyfriend got the fried chicken with both the 24k sauce and jam sauce, as well as the pineapple coleslaw on top. We were both in heaven! 

My only regret? That we didn't check this place out sooner!
Great neighborhood corner spot! Prices higher then your typical breakfast spot bit worth it as the quality and quantity are all you seek.

My husband and I had previously visited this place a few years ago and it was amazing!  We finally found this place again on our anniversary and it was just okay.. 

We went on a Tuesday and there was only 2 other parties there at around 11am 

Our tug boats came out cold... only thing that was hot was our poached eggs. Kind of weird. I had the fried chicken and husband had the carnitas. The carnitas was literally ice cold. We were on our way out of town so we didn't want to have them remake our food. 

Michelada was fantastic !
Pretty good. Very valued pricing. Good was eh, I'd eat there again but no unless it was on my way somewhere. Wouldn't go out of my way.
Delicious. And fresh. VERY busy. The rolls with scallops are different. The scallops are chopped and added into the roll - made me feel as though I was getting jipped on then actual scallops.

Beautiful presentation fabulous. The sushi delicious. The service was gruff but attentive. The quality, taste, and presentation more than any misstep that wasn't really made. I really enjoyed my experience at Matoi Sushi and I will definitely be going back.
It be best food! I love getting ramen here and it's great that they have a drive theough
We had shrimp grit, french toast, rollex, eggs Benedict , chai latte and mocha. Everything was awesome except eggs Benedict, the chicken was very hard to chew. Everything else was excellent!

Great for watching  a game like most locations in the chain. However, sorry to saag that the service at this location is never on point, outside of the bar area. If  looking for a good experience, sit at the bar for best chance of good service.
Now our favorite pizza in Medford. Great sauce, lots of fresh toppings we get ours well done and perfect every time. The prime rib sandwich is awesome

Had a very nice experience here.  Very friendly and efficient employee took my order, and the restaurant seemed clean.  Food order came out quick.  I did have to go back up for breadsticks as they forgot to give them with our meal, but otherwise it was tasty and I would come back.
Do not attempt curb side service on Cinco de Mayo unless you are prepared.  Epic failure.   Dinner supposed to be ready at 630.  Finally cancelled and left at 830.

I love this place!!! Chef Will knows what he's doing, the food is amazing. My first time coming out to eat since Covid and I'm so glad we came here. Its only outdoor seating right now and the outdoor patio is so nice .... it's like having you're own private area. I ordered the crab cake sandwich and my boyfriend ordered the duck... very very tasty... interesting flavors. Crispy and delicious. 
the staff was super nice n friendly too. So so so very good. Really glad to see this place open!!!!!
Good food good service, was Nicos before and now Fitos but it's still own and operated by the same family since 2009 (Nicos Family), nothing has changed but the name. Try El Rancho Burrito!
Obsessed with their orange cold brew coffee! So tasty and unique! Great prices also. Don't change a thing!

Possibly my new Taco Tuesday spot! I was on the hunt for another $1 taco special on the Westbank and a friend told me about this place so I had to try it out. I came in on the tail end of the lunch rush (1ish) and everyone was starting to leave. Every table seemed to be filled so if you're coming around noon, be prepared to wait. They have all the usual proteins for $1 street tacos.... but wait.... there's more!  They also include steak and shrimp to the selection! I eat my tacos with only 1 of the tortillas instead of the two layers they provide. When I separate the tortillas at other places, it breaks apart and all the goodies fall out. However, this place was the complete opposite. Everything was intact and ready for my devouring. All the tacos were great and I will be back. 

Side notes:

The salsa they provide with the chips have a spicy kick to it. (And I love spicy)

They don't sit parties more than 6 people on Tuesday.

My server Kenia was great

Excellent food, many different options, personally I got the waffle burger which was amazing, my wife had the brisket which I tried and was also good. Alchohol choices were good, had some inventive drinks and some old favorites, also have whiskey flights to let you try a few different ones. Waitress was friendly, there was no wait to be seated. Everything was great I will definitely go out of my way to come here again.
Really wanted some take out and Freddy's is what I decided, drove 25 minutes out to get an uncooked burger. Never again.

Excellent service by Gus our server. Very pretty. Portions generous. We had the pasta bolognese which was very flavorful. We also had the grilled octopus. Very tender. Most diners were doing the tasting menu. We were catching a quick bite before Cubs/Cards game. Cubs won!

Good, very good. Authentic Chinese food that is very good, traditional and without much American influences aka fusion. It's nice to find traditional food without the fusion aspect, sometimes the old school way is the best.

Had the pizza through catering, it was filling and flavorful. The variety in menu options is well accommodated by the ingredients. The Four Cheese Veggie Pizza was appetizing and fresh, with creamy ricotta and a blended mix of four cheeses. It was thin, but worked well to my preference, the crust balanced out the toppings well. Not too doughy, while not flaky, a crispy bread supported the refreshing mix of cheese and vegetables. Quite aptly named "an exciting pizza". The garlic knots were a bit too oily for my liking, and a bit under seasoned, nothing too irredeemable though.

I'm obsessed with this place.   I eat out a lot,  and it's definitely one of my favorites.   I know they have cupcakes from Flying Cupcake,  but the other dishes are the real standouts.   The Butter Poached Shrimp Salad and Mushroom Brie soup are a couple of my favorites.   All of the breakfast options are also worth the trip.  They have an absolutely charming outdoor patio, and you can stroll around Zionsville after eating to help work off the calories.  Staff is super friendly and service is awesome.

Always great food. I enjoy the sushi and sushi like menu. 
However, I always call in to pick up. They say 15 to 20 minutes, but its always 45 to an hour and a half. Seriously, no joke. So I wait with a group of people, who I'm trying to avoid, every time. 

Be honest with wait time. This would be a 5 star review, but this happens EVERY SINGLE TIME. 

I UNDERSTAND ITS A SMALL RESTAURANT, ITS POPULAR, ETC.  Definitely suggest try it out. Bus again, be honest about the wait time....

I came this morning after arraignment court shut down for a few hours and I am so happy I did! The pancakes are delicious! My server told me the pancakes would be the size of my head and they were right! The portions are generous and the food reminds me of when I lived in Georgia. Kayce cheered up a dreary morning and gave me some amazing recommendations. Can't wait to come back for the food and Kayce!

This is a great place to eat, if you're in the Philly area. It has a great indoor decor, and is very "instagrammable". For food I had their huge nacho plate and it was really tasty and filling. I could honestly barely finish the plate. I had chicken as an add on to my nacho plate, but I don't think that was necessary. Will definitely go back and try more of their dishes if I'm ever back in Philly.

The soul food was outstanding!  I have been dying to have liver and onions and dressing for almost 2 years.  It was very tender flavorful and filling; just the way that my mother makes it! 

The southern style country dressing was very tasteful and juicy.  The recipe can't be matched I've been attempting to make dressing for years and it's never taste as good!!

I try pear cobbler for the first time.  I was a bit apprehensive at first because traditionally I buy peach cobbler but decided to give it a try and let's say that it was outstanding as well!!!

Best soul food in town!!!! Period.

Food is good as it is at all of them. Staff is super friendly. Broccoli cheddar soup is super good, with the turkey blt doesn't get better unless you get the green tea. The only thing wrong with this location is the bathroom were absolutely Disgusting!! Restrooms out in public are already a horrible experience, if there bathroom isn't clean makes me think how they clean dishes and where they make our food. This was at 10:30 am, so it wasn't to far from them opening.

Hey if you are visiting Santa Barbara, you have to go to Brass Bear Brewing.  Amazing food and great beer . Wonderful service. If you don't stop in your missing a great place . Had tri tip skewers the best Ive ever had! Amazing sides to go with!

We got take out for dinner and I wasn't expecting much, don't know why, just wasn't.  Well was I surprised.  Everything we got was quite good.
I had a pulled pork sandwich with cole slaw and Mac & cheese.  Other then the top of my bun being a little burned (I actually didn't mind) my food was great. Pork was tender and juicy, slaw not overly dressed and Mac & Cheese creamy and yummy.  I had the bread pudding for dessert. It was cold so I warmed it up a bit and added some whipped cream. Mmmmmmm.  It did have nuts in it which was new to me. Wasn't the best I've eaten but was quite good,
Hubby had the brisket platter with Brunswick stew. It came with a piece of Texas toast which he said was actually toasted and buttered. He loved the stew ( I tasted it and found it a bit salty) and his brisket was a little dry. He had ordered the lean and said next time he'll order the "wet".  He had the peach cobbler for dessert. They need to add more peach to this it was mostly "cake".
We will definitely eat here again. I cannot comment on the restaurant itself or the staff since we took the food out and I did not go in to pick it up. With a few little tweaks I think this place could become 5 stars!

Updating for the covid episode of 2020.

Pegs is usually a standing room only place.  Packed on almost every day.  Now...because of the regulations they are at 25%.  Because of this limited capacity the have also decided to go with a more streamlined menu.  Gone are the traditional benedicts and they only have the country benedicts.

But my favorite meal is still available thank god.  The chile relleno skillet is for sure a top 10 breakfast meal in all of Reno.

We usually find ourselves here at least once a week during covid because it's close to home and they seem to be taking it seriously from masks to social distancing and keeping to 25%.  Customer service is still excellent and their food quality is always top notch.

And sadly close parking seems to be always plentiful these days.
Best hawaiian food in the continental US.  I think better than some of the food we had in Hawaii!   Huli Huli is Yum and the trio plate is also yummy!

Amazing food right here at Philadelphia Chinatown.  if you want quality food unlike any other hot pot down the street this is it.   

Kai the main chef really controlling the food quality with great effort.   

Matthew the owner providing excellent customer service upfront.  

I will definitely recommend this place to all my friends that knows about quality food.

I've been meaning to write this since November 2019. Tequilas' staff went above and beyond for a social mixer (for a conference). I arranged it from Los Angeles, and they were great! On the day of, they let me in to set up a few arrangements early. The staff was very attentive. The food and drinks were tasty and plentiful. Everyone enjoyed the venue, the staff, food and drinks. Thank you for being so patient, helpful and attentive!
Dry, overpriced, flavorless. Covid is no reason for poor quality. Been to Corky's before, wasn't impressed. No need for a 3rd time, no charm to be had.

Absolutely love this place! Can't decide whether I like their pork banh mi or vermicelli better- they're both excellent! Very fresh ingredients and the sauces are so flavorful without being overpowering. Hands down some of the best Vietnamese in NOLA!
